points.quote: `workbench.desktop.main.ts` imports `./electron-browser/desktop.main.js` and `desktop.contribution.js`, then Electron-specific services such as `nativeTextFileService`
`workbench.web.main.ts` imports `./browser/web.main.js`, then browser-specific services such as `services/search/browser/...`
`src/vs/workbench/workbench.common.main.ts` is the shared entry point. ... The platform entry points import it first and then add their own files
Each service has an interface plus per-platform implementations, which the platform entry files choose between.
If no entry file imports a feature's `*.contribution.ts`, the bundler never includes it.
Features register themselves as a side effect of being imported. ... If no entry file imports a feature's `*.contribution.ts`, the bundler never includes it.
